name: Persons
description: Persons capabilities. Includes Get person properties as they existed at a specific point in time, List the status of queued event deletions for persons, Only for setting properties on the person, Reset a distinct_id for a deleted person, Split distinct_ids off a merged person, This endpoint allows you to bulk delete persons, either by the PostHog person IDs or by distinct IDs, This endpoint is meant for reading and deleting persons.
